description: This file defines the AcpGatewayAgent class implementing the Agent interface for managing sessions, handling events, and communication with a gateway in an OpenClaw-like system. It includes methods for session management, event handling, and prompt processing, with detailed internal state management and error handling.

classes.name: AcpGatewayAgent
classes.description: Implements the Agent interface to manage sessions, handle events, prompts, and communication with a gateway, including session snapshot management, event processing, and disconnect handling.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the agent and logs readiness.

methods.name: handleGatewayReconnect
methods.description: Handles reconnection logic, including reconciling pending prompts after a gateway reconnection.

methods.name: handleGatewayDisconnect
methods.description: Handles gateway disconnection, setting up disconnect context and timers.

methods.name: handleGatewayEvent
methods.description: Dispatches incoming events to specific handlers based on event type.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Provides agent capabilities and info during initialization.

methods.name: newSession
methods.description: Creates a new session, updates session store, and sends initial session snapshot.

methods.name: loadSession
methods.description: Loads an existing session, replays transcript, and updates session snapshot.

methods.name: unstable_listSessions
methods.description: Lists sessions with optional limit, returning session summaries.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Handles authentication requests, currently returns empty response.

methods.name: setSessionMode
methods.description: Sets the session mode and updates the session snapshot.

methods.name: setSessionConfigOption
methods.description: Updates session configuration options and refreshes snapshot.

methods.name: prompt
methods.description: Processes user prompts, manages prompt state, and sends chat requests.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels active prompts and requests aborts from the gateway.

methods.name: resolveSessionKeyFromMeta
methods.description: Resolves session key from metadata, resetting session if needed.

methods.name: handleAgentEvent
methods.description: Handles agent-related events, including tool calls and updates.

methods.name: handleChatEvent
methods.description: Handles chat events, including message delta updates and final responses.

methods.name: handleDeltaEvent
methods.description: Processes incremental message content updates, updating agent message and thought chunks.

methods.name: finishPrompt
methods.description: Completes a prompt, clears state, and updates session snapshot.

methods.name: findPendingBySessionKey
methods.description: Finds a pending prompt by session key and run ID.

methods.name: clearDisconnectTimer
methods.description: Clears the disconnect timer if set.

methods.name: armDisconnectTimer
methods.description: Sets a timer to handle disconnection grace period.

methods.name: rejectPendingPrompt
methods.description: Rejects a pending prompt with an error, clearing state.

methods.name: clearPendingDisconnectState
methods.description: Clears disconnect context from a pending prompt if matching.

methods.name: shouldRejectPendingAtDisconnectDeadline
methods.description: Determines if a pending prompt should be rejected at disconnect deadline.

methods.name: reconcilePendingPrompts
methods.description: Reconciles all pending prompts after disconnection or timeout.

methods.name: reconcilePendingPrompt
methods.description: Reconciles individual pending prompt, possibly finishing or rejecting it.

methods.name: sendAvailableCommands
methods.description: Sends available commands update to the session.

methods.name: getSessionSnapshot
methods.description: Retrieves session snapshot including presentation, metadata, and usage.

methods.name: getGatewaySessionRow
methods.description: Fetches session row data from the gateway.

methods.name: resolveSessionConfigPatch
methods.description: Resolves configuration patch and overrides for session options.

methods.name: getSessionTranscript
methods.description: Fetches session transcript messages from the gateway.

methods.name: replaySessionTranscript
methods.description: Replays session transcript messages into the connection.

methods.name: sendSessionSnapshotUpdate
methods.description: Sends session snapshot data to the connection.

methods.name: assertSupportedSessionSetup
methods.description: Checks if session setup with MCP servers is supported.

methods.name: enforceSessionCreateRateLimit
methods.description: Enforces rate limiting for session creation requests.
